title: valeriana sambucifolia var. calvescens
intro: Valeriana sambucifolia var. calvescens, commonly known as a plant of the Valerianaceae family, is a variety of the Sambucifolia species within the Valeriana genus. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana sambucifolia var. calvescens are attributed to its ability to interact with the nervous system, promoting relaxation and reducing muscle spasms, as well as its antimicrobial and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include valepotriates, isovaleramate, and lignans, which contribute to its sedative and antispasmodic effects.
